newsitem.title: FRANCE: Journal du Dimanche says has no poll results.
newsitem.headline: Journal du Dimanche says has no poll results.

text.p: An official at France's Sunday newspaper Journal du Dimanche said he had not received any opinion poll results from polling organisation IFOP and was under the impression the poll was still being conducted.

Futures traders in Paris said market talk that an opinion poll conducted by IFOP for the Journal du Dimanche would show a slim majority for the opposition left was weighing on interest rate futures, bond futures and the franc.
"The polling finishes this evening. We will have the results fairly late tomorrow," he told Reuters. He joked that the market rumours were "slightly premature".
Officials at IFOP were not immediately available for comment.
